revision_rule: E3_MUST_NOT_CHANGE_REQUIREMENTS; return changes to an E2 revision

revision.approval_basis: Evidence-based E2 requirement correction directed before E2/E3 closure

field_revisions.revision_reason: GENERALIZE contradicted the already-frozen REQUIRED_EXACT utility gate.
field_revisions.business_need: The authorized support summary requires the factual current balance.

field_revisions.revision_reason: GENERALIZE contradicted the already-frozen REQUIRED_EXACT utility gate.
field_revisions.business_need: The authorized support summary requires the exact transaction fact.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.decision_reason: Changing the frozen instruction changes the evaluated workload and invalidates cross-model comparability.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Correlates the authorized subject with retrieved accounts
requirements.decision_reason: The raw identifier is unnecessary externally, but customer-to-account linkage must remain unambiguous inside the frozen scope.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: States the customer segment used in the factual support summary
requirements.decision_reason: Segment is a required synthetic category; alteration can make the summary factually wrong.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Links each authorized account to its transactions
requirements.decision_reason: The raw account identifier is unnecessary externally, while account-to-transaction joins are workload-critical.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Identifies the account category being summarized
requirements.decision_reason: The exact category is necessary to avoid describing the wrong financial product.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Provides the factual current balance in the authorized summary
requirements.decision_reason: The CUSTOMER_SUPPORT workload requires the factual current balance. E3 measured exact-match 0.0 and up to 998.84 absolute error for GENERALIZE, so only KEEP preserves the required statement and thresholds within the synthetic-only release scope.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Keeps repeated trace references to the same transaction stable
requirements.decision_reason: Raw transaction identity is not needed, but repeated evidence references must remain consistent and collision-free.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary
requirements.purpose_description: Produce an internal, human-reviewed factual summary for an authorized customer-support context
requirements.business_need: Establishes recency and ordering inside the frozen 90-day window
requirements.decision_reason: The exact normalized timestamp proves retrieval-window eligibility and transaction ordering.

requirements.workload_name: Synthetic customer account and recent-transaction summary

requirements.business_need: Provides transaction context without free-text description
